rationale: Sharon's TheAgentic.Ai is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure for high-stakes industries like biotech and fintech—exactly the frontier Ivan explicitly wants to connect with. intro_message: Sharon, meet Ivan Ivanka — he's obsessed with multi-agent orchestration and is actively looking to connect with founders building AI infrastructure; your work on production-ready agent systems for regulated industries could be exactly what he's scouting for.
